name: TD Business Solutions Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR on purchases for the first 12 billing cycles after account opening. After that, 17.49%, 22.49% or 27.49% variable APR based on creditworthiness. Balance transfer APR is 17.49%, 22.49% or 27.49% variable.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 3% of each transaction in U.S. dollars.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 2% Cash Back on all eligible purchases. No rotating spend categories, no caps or limits as long as your credit card account is open and in good standing.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back earned is redeemed in the form of a statement credit.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $400 Cash Back in the form of a statement credit when you spend $3,000 within the first 90 days after account opening. Maximum bonus accumulation for this promotional offer is 40,000 Bonus Points, equal to $400.

benefits.title: Visa Spend Clarity for Business
benefits.description: At no cost to you, access a suite of spend management tools to keep spending on track with dashboards and reporting, card controls and integration with accounting software.

benefits.title: Employee Cards at No Cost
benefits.description: Add Employee cards at no cost with the ability to set spending limits.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Get Visa benefits like cell phone protection when you pay your monthly mobile bill with your card.

benefits.title: Visa Zero Liability
benefits.description: Enjoy Visa security on purchases, plus protection against unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Emergency Card Replacement
benefits.description: Every TD Bank Credit Card comes with an added layer of protection such as emergency card replacement.

benefits.title: Roadside Assistance
benefits.description: Every TD Bank Credit Card comes with roadside assistance and more.

notes: Verified from official product page. Unlimited 2% cash back on all eligible purchases with no caps or limits. No annual fee. 0% intro APR on purchases for first 12 billing cycles, then 17.49%-27.49% variable. Foreign transaction fee 3%.
